parallels.note: Sing to Yahweh, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.

translations.web: Sing to Yahweh! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
translations.bsb: Sing to the LORD, bless His name; proclaim His salvation day after day.
translations.kjv: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
translations.asv: Sing unto Jehovah, bless his name; Show forth his salvation from day to day.
